description: This line plot illustrates how the performance or relevance of three types of code retrieval sources—Tutorials, Library Documentation, and Github files—varies with the number of tokens in a query. The x-axis represents the “Number of Tokens,” ranging from 200 to 800 in a linear scale, with tick marks labeled at intervals of 200. The y-axis, which is also linear, measures an unspecified metric ranging from 10 to 40. The blue line, representing “Tutorials,” starts at approximately 23, rises to about 29 at 500 tokens, and then slightly declines to around 28 at 800 tokens. The red line, for “Library Documentation,” begins near 27, increases to approximately 31 at 500 tokens, and then decreases to about 28 at 800 tokens. The green line, indicating “Github files,” starts at about 28, rises to roughly 31 at 500 tokens, and then slightly declines to approximately 29 at 800 tokens. The yellow line, which appears to correspond to “Library Documentation” based on the legend, starts at about 32, decreases steadily to approximately 12 at 800 tokens. All lines are marked with circular points and connected by solid lines.
